title: Multifunctional animal repellent snake repeller
body_html:
Package List:

1x Solar ultrasonic repeller
1x User manual

Specification:

Name: solar ultrasonic repeller
Material: plastic PP（polypropylene）, ABS（Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene）
Shell Color: green
Battery: 3* AA rechargeable battery (The battery is NOT included)
Rate of work supply: solar board (Can be spplied by 5V 500mA adapter)
Energy board: amorphous 5V 60mA
Quantity of speakers: 4
Induction distance: 3-10m
Level detection angle: 110°
Function: infrared sensing
Product size: 43*16CM (16.9*6.3INCH)
Frequency: 13.5KHz-28.5KHz, 400Hz-1000Hz (5 gear)
Waterproof: IP44
Installation: inserted on the ground


Feature:
-Use solar energy, rate of work can be spplied by 5V 500mA adapter
-Use ultrasonic wave to scare animal away
-Eco-friendly, Chemical free, safe to human
-Wireless and convenience in using
-Easy installation, inserted on the ground
-Can effectively repel unwanted animals such as mice, rats, rabbits, squirrels, raccoons, skunks, stray cats, stray dogs, etc
